This report compares trained context-dependent sequencing error models across all
platforms using held-out likelihood and AIC.  Per-model parameter plots are
disabled here by default to keep rendering fast.

To produce a per-platform report with full parameter plots, render with:

```bash
quarto render context_error_model_report.qmd \
  -P platform:lq-illumina \
  -P show_per_model_plots:true \
  -o context_error_model_lq_illumina.html
```

Or open one of the pre-configured per-platform notebooks:
`context_error_model_lq_illumina.qmd`, `context_error_model_hq_illumina.qmd`,
`context_error_model_ont.qmd`, `context_error_model_pacbio.qmd`.

```{python}
#| echo: false
from pathlib import Path
import os

PARAMS = globals().get("params", {
    "results_dir": "../context_error_models",
    "platform": "all",
    "artifact_glob": "*.pt",
    "max_volcano_points": 50000,
    "top_parameters": 80,
    "max_heatmap_contexts": 80,
    "heatmap_context_sample": 500,
    "show_per_model_plots": False,
})

RESULTS_DIR = Path(
    os.environ.get("CONTEXT_RESULTS_DIR", PARAMS.get("results_dir", "../context_error_models"))
).expanduser()
PLATFORM = str(os.environ.get("CONTEXT_PLATFORM", PARAMS.get("platform", "all")))
ARTIFACT_GLOB = str(os.environ.get("CONTEXT_ARTIFACT_GLOB", PARAMS.get("artifact_glob", "*.pt")))
MAX_VOLCANO_POINTS = int(os.environ.get("CONTEXT_MAX_VOLCANO_POINTS", PARAMS.get("max_volcano_points", 50000)))
TOP_PARAMETERS = int(os.environ.get("CONTEXT_TOP_PARAMETERS", PARAMS.get("top_parameters", 80)))
MAX_HEATMAP_CONTEXTS = int(os.environ.get("CONTEXT_MAX_HEATMAP_CONTEXTS", PARAMS.get("max_heatmap_contexts", 80)))
HEATMAP_CONTEXT_SAMPLE = int(os.environ.get("CONTEXT_HEATMAP_CONTEXT_SAMPLE", PARAMS.get("heatmap_context_sample", 500)))
SHOW_PER_MODEL_PLOTS = str(PARAMS.get("show_per_model_plots", False)).lower() not in ("false", "0", "no")

print(f"Results directory : {RESULTS_DIR.resolve()}")
print(f"Platform filter   : {PLATFORM}")
print(f"Artifact glob     : {ARTIFACT_GLOB}")
print(f"Per-model plots   : {SHOW_PER_MODEL_PLOTS}")
```
